title: Database disk full
reason: The engineer correctly identified the database as the broken part, the disk‑full problem, and the new nightly backup job as the trigger.
option_titles: Move oldest backup and disable backup job
root_cause: The nightly database backup job writes full-size dump files to /var/lib/postgresql/backups on the same volume as PostgreSQL data, filling the disk to 100% and preventing PostgreSQL from extending its data files, which causes order placement failures.
truth: The disk /var/lib/postgresql is 100% full because the new nightly backup job saves its dumps on the same disk, so PostgreSQL cannot write new data.
